instruction.text: We're going to start by looking at a long hallway but rather looking at that hallway we're going to make a 180 degree turn to face another hallway. Where on the right side are some elevators and on the left side are some windows. We're going to make our way down this long hallway and on our way we're going closed doors and more windows. Towards the end we will see a desk which is brown. We're going to keep making our way down the hallway until we reach a gold helping guide. Once we reach the end of the hallway we'll see this large tile square with a circle in the middle that also has a little glass stand with a flower piece in the middle. On the square we'er going to make our way towards the top right so that we are close to the top right of the square and we're able to see all the furniture in the area.
